issues.detail: Instructions assume local Python/bash execution capabilities that may not be equally supported across all listed compatible tools (e.g., OpenAI Codex).

scenarios.name: invoice-pdf-extraction
scenarios.rationale: Both correctly identify the missing PDF prerequisite and cannot execute the rubric's core requirements (pdfplumber extraction, regex patterns, JSON/CSV outputs), but Response A provides more helpful guidance on how to supply the file (upload or path), making it marginally better at facilitating the actual task.

scenarios.name: scanned-form-ocr-extraction
scenarios.rationale: Response A asks for the image but provides no demonstration of the required methodology; Response B directly addresses all rubric requirements—showing OCR with pytesseract, regex patterns for all four fields with email validation, and extraction logic—despite also requesting the image file.

scenarios.name: batch-docx-consolidation
scenarios.rationale: Response A asks clarifying questions but provides zero implementation code, failing to meet any rubric requirement. Response B delivers working code with python-docx iteration, regex email extraction, text/table parsing, clean lowercase column names, and CSV export—but uses a dict list instead of explicitly creating a pandas DataFrame as required, missing one specific rubric element while being otherwise complete and runnable.
